name: web-fashion-site-collage-with-giant-black-caps-and-script-signature
title: Fashion site shown between giant black grotesque caps with an orange script signature
whatItIs: A white cover where a fashion brand website sits between two huge cropped black words, 'COLLECTION 26' above and 'BEAUCLAIRE' below. A strip of model photos runs across the top, an orange script name 'Odette' is signed over the hero, and small orange pill buttons and tags dot the layout.
whatItMeans: Bold and editorial; monumental type and a hand signature make a store feel like a magazine.
techniques: Sandwich a UI between crop-bled giant heavy caps.
Sign a script name over the hero photo.
Use a single orange for buttons and tags.
Line photos in a strip above the page.

vocabulary.definition: Giant words above and below an image or UI.
Handwritten lettering laid over a photo.
A row of small images along an edge.
A small button in the single accent colour.
